structural_anchors.text: a natural photograph of exactly one complete whole plant entirely inside the frame, from the soil-contact base to the highest crown
one plant whose complete ground-contact base and lowest stems are clearly visible
one plant whose complete crown, canopy, or highest leaves are clearly visible inside the frame
exactly one isolated dominant plant, clearly separated from sparse background vegetation
a clear natural-color field photograph of a plant, not a document, specimen, sign, or collage

grass_clump.text: one complete compact desert bunchgrass tussock with all narrow blades arising from one visible basal clump
an isolated whole grass clump on dry ground with its tufted base and entire top visible
one small non-woody tufted grass plant, not a bush or tree

low_shrub.text: one complete low woody desert shrub with a visible ground base and full compact crown
an isolated low bush with several woody stems arising near the ground and no tall dominant trunk
a full view of one small rounded scrub plant on dry ground, entirely inside the frame

young_tree.text: one complete young desert tree sapling with its ground base, slender trunk, and entire modest crown visible
a small juvenile tree or seedling, clearly not a mature large tree
one isolated upright sapling with a thin dominant trunk and compact canopy entirely in frame

hard_reject_prompts.text: a close-up or macro photograph of a flower, grass seed head, inflorescence, fruit, or pod rather than a whole plant
a close-up of leaves, thorns, twigs, or one branch rather than a whole plant
a close-up of bark, a trunk, or cut wood rather than a whole plant
a cropped plant photograph where the ground-contact base or lower plant is outside the frame
a cropped plant photograph where the crown, canopy, or upper plant is outside the frame
a human hand holding a plant part, or a person dominating the image
a herbarium specimen, botanical plate, document, label, sign, map, screenshot, or text page
a dense plant community, field, meadow, or thicket with many overlapping plants
several separate plants share the foreground and no single isolated plant is the only subject
a wide landscape where plants are small background objects and no single whole plant dominates
a mature large tree with a thick trunk and broad established canopy, not a young sapling
a dead leafless tree, distant tree silhouette, or severely damaged tree
a vehicle, machine, building, garden sign, or other man-made object is a major subject
